component.name: Glaukopis
component.summary: References, ideas in mind maps, writing, and the manuscript

description.p: Glaukopis is where the work on an academic book or article is done. It is made for scholars in the humanities and the social sciences, and for a way of working that starts from references and ideas.

ul.li: Ideas are developed in mind maps, which are read as diagrams or as text, and grow into the manuscript.
References are kept in one BibLaTeX file, which other tools can read, with their files.
The manuscript is previewed as it is written, and exported to PDF, LaTeX, ODT and DOCX in the reference style and the format that a publisher asks for.
A project can be shared through a server of one's own, and written in by several at the same time.
